agents.name: upload_rfq_file
agents.description: Upload a design file (STEP/STP, IGES/IGS, STL, 3MF, OBJ, DXF, DWG, PDF, ZIP (Gerber files go in a ZIP); up to 6 MB as base64 here, up to 100 MB with POST /api/v1/rfq/files?name=...). Returns a file_id to pass in create_rfq file_ids. Unused
reasons: The tool explicitly supports uploading STL design files for RFQ (Request for Quote) purposes.
uncertainties: Execution requires a fresh readiness check.

agents.name: Request a quote from matching suppliers
agents.description: Send a quote request to whobuildsit, which reviews it and passes it to suppliers who can make the part. Before calling, ASK THE USER for their work email and explicit consent to share the request and email with suppliers — never invent an e
reasons: This tool is designed to send a quote request to suppliers after a design file has been uploaded.
